deploymentEvidence.sourceType: archived official BabySwap smart-contract deployment documentation plus exact-address Sourcify verification
deploymentEvidence.evidence: Archived official Smart Contracts page explicitly labels BabySwap: Router and links this exact BscScan address under Main contracts. Exact-chain/address Sourcify record names contracts/router/BabyRouter.sol:BabyRouter and supplies deployment identity, complete verified ABI/source and non-proxy resolution. This is the legacy explicit V2-style router, not the separate BabySmartRouter.
limitations: Live official docs domain was unreachable; deployment mapping was retrieved from the dated Internet Archive capture of the official domain.

Official repository URL https://github.com/babyswap/baby-swap-contract and raw main README returned HTTP 404. A surviving third-party mirror is supplementary only and is not represented as an official deployment source.
BscScan direct address request returned HTTP 403. Exact-address ABI/source was obtained independently from Sourcify; no live RPC bytecode/state or execution check was performed.

abiEvidence.sourceType: exact-chain/address Sourcify v2 ABI and verified multi-file source
abiEvidence.sourceHashRecipe: SHA-256 of UTF-8 sources[contracts/router/BabyRouter.sol].content from the exact-address Sourcify response, without normalization.
abiEvidence.evidence: Full ABI is copied from this exact deployment Sourcify abi array, not from Uniswap/PancakeSwap or a generic fork interface. The deployment-specific surface includes Ownable and swapMining/setSwapMining. Sourcify reports exact_match for creation and runtime; these are service-reported verification evidence, not an independent live runtime attestation.
abiEvidence.supplementaryMirrorEvidence: Pinned surviving third-party mirror mainnet deployment lists the same address. Its BabyRouter.sol matches the address-bound router source after CRLF-to-LF normalization and trimming; not used in place of the exact-address ABI or official archived deployment mapping.

reviewSummary.admittedScope: Nine explicit swaps and five non-permit liquidity actions; no permits, administration, callbacks or opaque executors.
reviewSummary.excludedScope: Nine read-only/pure getters/quotes, three permit/signature liquidity variants and three owner administrative functions.
reviewSummary.configurationRisk: Both ordinary and fee-on-transfer swap loops invoke owner-configurable swapMining once per hop when nonzero. Current owner/hook configuration and hook behavior are not checked. Immutable factory and WETH identities are recorded from constructor evidence.
reviewSummary.taxAndWholeBalanceRisk: Supporting native liquidity removal transfers whole router token balance and does not guarantee net post-tax token proceeds; supporting token/native swaps unwrap whole router WBNB balance. Token-output supporting swaps use recipient balance deltas.
reviewSummary.nativeRisk: Four payable actions spend native BNB despite ETH naming. Native-output swaps/removals unwrap WBNB; receiver/refund transfer behavior and nonstandard tokens can revert.
reviewSummary.legacySourceDebugCalls: Address-bound source retains hardhat console.log calls in removeLiquidity. These fixed console staticcalls are not a user-supplied executor; no console/callback capability is created and successful execution is not asserted.

skippedDeployment.reason: Not the legacy target. Separate smart router exposes per-hop caller-selected factories/fees and a payable fallback delegating to its normalRouter. No smart-router or fallback surface is admitted by this evidence.
